request.query: Summing an indexed zero-preserving function over a finitely supported single equals evaluation at that index and coefficient

items.name: Finsupp.sum_ite_eq
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_2 : DecidableEq α]
  (f : α →₀ M) (a : α) (b : α → M → N),
  (f.sum fun x v => if a = x then b x v else 0) = if a ∈ f.support then b a (f a) else 0

items.name: Finsupp.sum_single_index
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {a : α} {b : M}
  {h : α → M → N}, h a 0 = 0 → (Finsupp.single a b).sum h = h a b

items.name: Finsupp.sum_eq_single
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {f : α →₀ M} (a : α)
  {g : α → M → N}, (∀ (b : α), f b ≠ 0 → b ≠ a → g b (f b) = 0) → (f a = 0 → g a 0 = 0) → f.sum g = g a (f a)

items.name: finsum
items.type: {M : Type u_7} → {α : Sort u_8} → [AddCommMonoid M] → (α → M) → M

items.name: DFinsupp.sumZeroHom_single
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} {γ : Type w} {β : ι → Type v} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → Zero (β i)]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid γ] (φ : (i : ι) → ZeroHom (β i) γ) (i : ι) (x : β i),
  (DFinsupp.sumZeroHom φ) (DFinsupp.single i x) = (φ i) x

items.name: DFinsupp.sum_single_index
Finsupp.sum_fintype
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_2 : Fintype α]
  (f : α →₀ M) (g : α → M → N), (∀ (i : α), g i 0 = 0) → f.sum g = ∑ i, g i (f i)

items.name: Finsupp.sum_ite_self_eq
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq α] {N : Type u_16} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ N) (a : α),
  (f.sum fun x v => if a = x then v else 0) = f a
